method_card.title: Equality and Inclusion
method_card.content:
This lesson covers equality, fairness and discrimination — a Higher-tier topic requiring abstract opinion language. You need to express views confidently, use connectives like sin embargo and aunque, and deploy the present subjunctive after impersonal expressions.

SpanishEnglish
la igualdadequality
la desigualdadinequality
la discriminacióndiscrimination
el racismoracism
el sexismosexism
la justiciajustice, fairness
los derechosrights
defenderto defend
comprometerseto commit / to engage
el compromisocommitment
respetarto respect
tratar a alguien con respetoto treat someone with respect
hay que + infinitiveone must / it is necessary to
sin embargohowever
aunquealthough / even though

Grammar focus: the present subjunctive after impersonal expressions. At Higher tier, you must use the subjunctive after expressions like es importante que, es necesario que, es fundamental que. The present subjunctive is formed by taking the yo present form, dropping the -o, and adding the opposite endings: -ar verbs take -e endings; -er/-ir verbs take -a endings.

Examples: Es importante que respetemos a todos. (It is important that we respect everyone.) Es necesario que haya igualdad. (It is necessary that there be equality.)

Opinion verbs: Creo que, Opino que, Pienso que, A mi modo de ver, En mi opinión. Connectives: sin embargo, aunque, por otro lado, a pesar de que, no obstante.

Model paragraph: Creo que la discriminación es un problema grave. Es importante que todos luchemos por la igualdad, aunque todavía hay mucho trabajo por hacer. Sin embargo, opino que la situación está mejorando poco a poco. (I think discrimination is a serious problem. It is important that we all fight for equality, although there is still a lot of work to do. However, I think the situation is gradually improving.)
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for equality and discrimination
Master opinion verbs and connectives for expressing balanced views
Practise es importante que / es necesario que + present subjunctive
Build extended arguments using aunque and sin embargo

exam_context.frequency: Higher-tier topic — abstract opinion language and subjunctive are rewarded in writing and speaking

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Creo que la igualdad es muy importante en la sociedad.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Creo que = I think that. la igualdad = equality.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: es muy importante = is very important. en la sociedad = in society.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I think that equality is very important in society.

worked_examples.question: How do you say 'It is important that everyone respects others'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with the impersonal expression: Es importante que. This triggers the subjunctive.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: respetar (to respect) → yo form: respeto → drop -o → respet- → add subjunctive ending for todo el mundo (everyone, treated as él/ella): respete.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Es importante que todo el mundo respete a los demás.

worked_examples.question: Build a complex opinion sentence using aunque and the subjunctive.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with your main opinion: Opino que la discriminación es inaceptable.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Add aunque (although) + subjunctive to show concession: aunque haya (although there may be) — haya is subjunctive of hay.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Opino que la discriminación es inaceptable, aunque haya personas que no estén de acuerdo. (I think discrimination is unacceptable, although there may be people who disagree.)

bronze.question: Match the Spanish to the English meaning
Match the Spanish to the English meaning

pairs.right: one must / it is necessary to

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: que la discriminación es un problema grave

gaps.correct_explain: Creo que = I think that. This introduces a subordinate clause expressing your view.

wrong.Quiero: Quiero means 'I want'. For opinions use Creo que, Pienso que or Opino que.

gaps.correct_explain: en la sociedad = in society. Use en for location.

wrong.para: para la sociedad would mean 'for society' (purpose). You need en (in).
wrong.a: a la sociedad is not used here. Use en for 'in society'.

gaps.correct_explain: tratar is the infinitive. After hay que, always use the infinitive.

wrong.trato: trato is the yo form (I treat). After hay que, use the infinitive → tratar.
wrong.tratan: tratan is the ellos/ellas form (they treat). After hay que, use the infinitive → tratar.

gaps.correct_explain: respeto is the noun meaning 'respect'. Con respeto = with respect.

wrong.respetar: respetar is the verb (to respect). Here you need the noun respeto.
wrong.respetan: respetan means 'they respect' (verb). You need the noun respeto.

bronze.question: What does 'Es necesario que todos luchemos por la igualdad' mean?
options: It is necessary that we all fight for equality
It is necessary to fight against equality
We all need to stop fighting

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly uses an opinion phrase?
options: En mi opinión, la discriminación es inaceptable.
En mi opinión, la discriminación está inaceptable.
En mi opinión es la discriminación inaceptable.
En mi opinión la discriminación ser inaceptable.

bronze.source_text: Creo que el racismo y el sexismo son problemas graves que hay que combatir.
model_answers: I think that racism and sexism are serious problems that we need to / must combat.
hints: hay que = one must / it is necessary to

bronze.question: Listen and type what you hear

silver.question: Complete the sentence
silver.english: Although there is still a lot of inequality, I think the situation is improving.

gaps.correct_explain: Aunque = although / even though. It introduces a concession before your main point.

wrong.Pero: Pero (but) connects two equal clauses. Aunque specifically means 'although' — a stronger concession.
wrong.Sin embargo: Sin embargo (however) typically comes after the main clause with a comma, not before it.

gaps.correct_explain: creo que = I think that. Opinion verbs introduce a subordinate clause.

wrong.quiero: quiero means 'I want', not 'I think'. Use an opinion verb: creo, pienso or opino.

gaps.correct_explain: está mejorando = is improving (present progressive). Use estar + gerund for ongoing actions.

wrong.es: es mejorando is wrong. For ongoing actions use estar + gerund: está mejorando.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Es importante que todo el mundo respeta los derechos de los demás.
silver.explanation: After es importante que, the verb must be in the present subjunctive: respete (not respeta, which is the present indicative). The subjunctive signals that the statement is a wish or requirement, not a fact.
silver.translation: It is important that everyone respects the rights of others.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: In my opinion, we must defend the rights of all people.

distractor_labels.todos: wrong agreement — personas is feminine, so todas not todos

silver.source_text: I think that everyone should be treated fairly. Discrimination is unacceptable.
model_answers: Creo que hay que tratar a todos con justicia. La discriminación es inaceptable.

silver.audio_text: Hay que luchar contra la discriminación en la sociedad.
silver.correct_text: Hay que luchar contra la discriminación en la sociedad.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: In my opinion, discrimination is a serious problem in our society. It is important that we all commit to defending equality, although there is still a lot of work to do.
model_answers: En mi opinión, la discriminación es un problema grave en nuestra sociedad. Es importante que todos nos comprometamos a defender la igualdad, aunque todavía hay mucho trabajo por hacer.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: It is necessary that the government defends the rights of all citizens.

distractor_labels.defiende: wrong mood — after es necesario que you need the subjunctive: defienda, not defiende (present indicative)
distractor_labels.defende: does not exist — the subjunctive of defender (yo: defiendo → subj.) is defienda
distractor_labels.ciudadanas: wrong gender — ciudadanos is masculine plural (mixed group), not ciudadanas (feminine)

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are talking to a Spanish student at a leisure centre. They ask you about equality and social issues in your country. Answer in Spanish.

bullets.prompt: Give your opinion on equality and whether it is important.
bullets.model_answer: Creo que la igualdad es fundamental. Es importante que todos los ciudadanos tengan los mismos derechos.
bullets.note: creo que + opinion + es importante que + subjunctive (tengan)

bullets.prompt: Say what discrimination means to you and give an example.
bullets.model_answer: Para mí, la discriminación significa tratar a las personas de forma injusta. El racismo, por ejemplo, es totalmente inaceptable.

bullets.prompt: Say what people must do to improve the situation.
bullets.model_answer: Hay que comprometerse a defender los derechos de todos, aunque a veces sea difícil.

bullets.prompt: Ask your conversation partner what they think about equality in their country.
bullets.model_answer: ¿Qué opinas sobre la igualdad en tu país?
bullets.note: question with ¿Qué opinas sobre...? — remember inverted ¿

gold.audio_text: Es importante que todos nos comprometamos a luchar por la igualdad y contra la discriminación.
gold.correct_text: Es importante que todos nos comprometamos a luchar por la igualdad y contra la discriminación.
gold.translation: It is important that we all commit to fighting for equality and against discrimination.

gold.question: Complete the sentence
gold.english: It is fundamental that the government fights for justice, even though it is difficult.

gaps.rule: Present subjunctive of luchar after es fundamental que
gaps.correct_explain: luche is the present subjunctive of luchar (el/ella form). After es fundamental que, use the subjunctive: lucho → drop -o → luch- → add -e.

wrong.lucha: lucha is the present indicative. After es fundamental que, you need the subjunctive → luche.
wrong.luchan: luchan is the plural present indicative. The subject is el gobierno (singular), and you need the subjunctive → luche.

gaps.rule: Present subjunctive of ser after aunque
gaps.correct_explain: sea is the present subjunctive of ser, used after aunque when the meaning is 'even though it might be'. Aunque + subjunctive = even if (uncertain); aunque + indicative = although (fact).

wrong.es: es is indicative (it is — as a fact). After aunque expressing a hypothetical, use the subjunctive → sea.
wrong.está: está is estar (not ser). For abstract qualities like 'difficult' use ser (subjunctive: sea).
